main_text.p: tolfe. Τὸ ἀδίκεῖν ἢ ἀδίκεῖν βέλτιον, to suffer wrong is better then to doe wrong. Si hoc tam notabile omisissem, non unus fortasse ofcitantium reprehendisset. Ingenuè tamen fateor subdubitare me an in ista constructione Anglicum to, sit loco articuli Græci. Sæpe enim ad exprimendum Latinorum gerundium in dum adhibetur hæc particula loco præpositionis ad: ut, And they rose to eate: & surrexerunt ad edendum, &c. Quò referas illa vetera, & longè elegantissima, to become thine rite: vel, to cpmcth thine rie: adveniat regnum tuum: in vetustis Orationis Dominicæ versionibus. Interdum etiam cum verbis eleganter coalescit ista particula; ut, And thees temple wæbzpit, wearth to sliten en midden; & velum templi sciffum est medium.
